europe_now.title: France pledges interceptor missiles to Ukraine amid escalating Russian strikes
europe_now.summary: France has committed to delivering interceptor missiles to Ukraine as part of its response to intensified Russian military actions. This follows reports of increased civilian casualties from Russian strikes.
